title: Estaria aplaudindo de pé, se fosse possível
body:
Gente, que doideira! É literalmente tudo que eu procurava num aplicativo de organização. Design bonito, ferramentas úteis, bom funcionamento... além de ser totalmente liderado por mulheres, pelo que entendi. Simplesmente admirável. Percebi apenas alguns bugs ao tentar adicionar tarefas repetitivas em dias específicos, mas isso ocorreu uma ou duas vezes e não foi algo que me incomodasse de fato (nem algo que eu não conseguisse resolver sozinha). Então, tudo limpo.

Antes, eu usava o próprio bloco de notas do iPhone para me organizar. Acontece que ter um espaço reservado exclusivamente para as funções do Tiimo é, para mim, inegociável. Por isso, estou muito feliz por tê-lo encontrado, principalmente porque sou uma jovem adulta diagnosticada com autismo — não é todo dia que acho bons programas focados em auxiliar principalmente pessoas neurodivergentes. ❤️

Ressalto que estou utilizando o plano mensal pago porque preciso visualizar as tarefas no meu notebook, ou seja, pelo Tiimo for Web. Infelizmente, meu dinheiro está curto, mas gostaria de atualizar meu plano para o anual. Talvez em breve! Agora, o meu sonho é que um aplicativo oficial seja lançado para Windows, rs.

Enfim! Parabéns a toda a equipe envolvida no desenvolvimento do programa! Que vocês prosperem muito. Abraços do Brasil. 🇧🇷🥰

title: It’s promising, but not quite there yet
body:
Overall, the app concept is great, I love the clean interface, cute designs, the way it breaks tasks down by time, and the to-do list reminders.

That said, there are a few points worth addressing:

1. The desktop and mobile versions don't sync reliably. When I make edits to events, changes sometimes fail to save with no error message or loading indicator to explain what's happening. There's a lot of lag when editing or setting up calendar events.

2. The calendar view on desktop also has an alignment issue. Events scheduled close together appear misaligned, stacking left and right inconsistently.

3. As for the AI feature, I honestly don't use it. It feels underdeveloped, more like a placeholder than a functional tool. It struggles to interpret prompts correctly and rarely generates tasks as expected. I'd rather see that effort invested in core product functionality like the calendar setup experience.

For an iPhone App of the Year, I'd expect it to be more polished. With some focused improvements it could live up to that title. I hope to see meaningful updates that make it worth renewing my subscription.

title: 10/10 - O app pra Organização & Produtividade.
body:
Esse app é pra quem:
• tem dificuldade em organizar o dia dentro do tempo que tem;
• não consegue estimar o tempo de execução de cada tarefa;
• perde a concentração e se vê fazendo algo que não deveria.

O app é extremamente completo. 
Concentra todos os calendários e lembretes necessários a você, e ainda tem uma sessão de gestão de backlog. Todos esses itens culminam numa página de agenda, que te mostra o que foi planejado pro dia e ainda te conta se as atividades estão dentro do previsto por você.

Ele ainda conta com um timer de foco, que te ajuda a entender quanto tempo falta, focar na tarefa e até compreender se as estimativas que você dá estão sendo exequíveis.

Claro, sem esquecer que de acordo com o nome dado a tarefa que precisa ser feito, ele ainda te ajuda e dividir em itens menores tá facilitar e direcionar a execução, criando subtarefas através de IA acoplada.

title: Unfortunately, not ADHD friendly
body:
I’m just letting this warning here because it was nowhere to be found before I purchased the app: they REMOVED THE “ROUTINE” FUNCTION in some update, despite promoting this feature in all of their communications. That said, this really doesn’t matter AS MUCH, since you can still create one activity called, let’s say… “Morning Routine” and have subtasks on it.

But as an ADHDer myself, this app has 2 flaws that I simply cannot understand, even more on an app that is made by and for us neurodivergents: 1) it “punishes” you if you are late for any activity 2) it does not allow to enter activities with a due date+time, but without a defined duration. Let me explain:

1)
ALL activities have an individual and automatic timer, that starts at the due date/time an it is great to be able to see the activity and the time passing by in real time WHEN YOU CAN MAKE IT ON TIME. Because if you, for some reason are late, you CANNOT STOP IT, or even edit it. Only pause it. Also, if you accidentally tap on the “play” button right above an activity, you cannot undo it. For both cases (activity already started or accidentally tap on “play” button), you have to delete the activity and re-insert it!

Let me give an example: I had a swimming class today on my Google Calendar at 10AM but the teacher couldn’t make it and just told me after 10AM. Tiimo has an integration with GC, so it imported the event, but right at 10pm the timer started to roll until 11am, automatically! You cannot edit ANY event, the imported and/or the ones we create originally in app, AFTER it starts.

I wrote an email about all I’m writing here, and they’ve confirmed: I have to DELETE the activity and re-insert it again, with the new date/time. And if the activity was imported from GC, I have to go out of the app, go to Google Calendar, delete and re-enter the event with the new date+time. That’s more time wasting and more opportunities to make mistakes and forget things…

2)
Another big flaw for me is that we cannot create activities/events without a defined duration. Let’s say I want to wash my dishes at 2PM, but I don’t know how much time it takes yet. We all know “time blindness” is a struggle for us with ADHD and Autism! But in this app, instead, I have to create an activity on the day I want and leave it as “any time of the day” option, and remember that I need to do it by 2PM myself. That’s right, a planning app in which you have to use your own memory (and we all know how bad our memories are, that’s why we look for apps in the first place)…

They give us another workaround, that is to create the “washing dishes” task with an approximate duration and DURING THE ACTIVITY, keep tapping the “+” icon to add more minutes. With my hands wet?! And if I was on my swimming class and it was longer than it usually is? I have to leave the pool running and go to the app to add more time before the class ends?

How frustrating it is, to set an arbitrary time for something, like “editing a video”, and have to pause the activity itself to get the phone and keep adding minutes? How distracting and disappointing it is?

So, basically, I need to pay for this app and for another one like Toggl to first track the time I take to do every single activity in my life and then use Tiimo. That doesn’t make sense.

And another consequence of this, is that I cannot have on the same app, my tasks/activities and basic reminders, like someone’s birthday or holiday! If you import a “moon phase” or any calendar I just mentioned to Tiimo that is just an reminder for the day (and not a task per se), you have to set a timing duration or it will be together with the “anytime” tasks during the day.

I just don’t understand… so now I have to pay for Tiimo, Toggl and have to leave the app and enter on my Calendar app to see “all day” events that aren’t tasks, like “credit card due date”, or “Easter”. That’s the perfect recipe for failure as someone who struggles with focus and attention!

_

So, to summarize, on Tiimo, I have the following results by the end of my day:

• A swimming lesson that I supposedly did, but in reality didn’t;

• A pile of dishes in the sink, that I now have to wash in the evening when I am out of energy and tired, because I couldn’t guess the duration, so the task went to the “anytime” tab, that was closed to avoid distractions from the main ones;

• A full afternoon supposedly without any activity,  because I needed to use another app to track the time I took to edit a video, so that I can add it more accurately on Tiimo the next time;

• Oh, and I forgot to call my friend on her birthday, because I couldn’t add this event on Tiimo without a task attached to it and didn’t entered my Calendar app today 

_
I know the creator’s intentions are good, so I don’t plan on lashing out here. I really have tried the workarounds, but all I did was waste my money and patience. I’ll be testing Tick-Tick now, since they have all the functions mentioned, a minimalist layout and widgets way more useful!

author: RootMassacre

title: Tem tudo pra ser o melhor app pra organização
body:
Estou simplesmente apaixonada pelo app, passei o dia procurando opções pois estou tendo muita dificuldade em me organizar como uma legítima tdah. Tem coisas a melhorar e ver o time super trabalhando pra atender às demandas solicitadas é incrível, nunca vi uma equipe assim. 

Seria legal tbm ter a opção de ter mostrar o dia em círculo cardiano, pra ter uma opção ainda visual e simplificada. Também seria legal dizer quantas tarefas faltam realizar no dia: por exemplo: faltam 7 tarefas, porque aí vai diminuindo é isso dá um alívio. 

Tô testando grátis pra ver se me adapto, mas acredito que em poucos dias não vou resistir e vou assinar, pois vocês se preocuparam em fazer algo tão lindo por nós neurodivergentes que é impossível resistir. 

Abraços a todos, fizeram meu dia feliz ;)
author: seilacomch

title: Tudo pra mim
body:
Esse aplicativo tem sido a diferença entre um dia em que eu me sinto perdida e sobrecarregada de informações e um dia em que consigo me planejar e seguir o plano.

Ainda tem alguns bugs, mas nada que atrapalhe o uso. Várias funções estão em implementação e o time do app está aberto pra escutar sugestões, elogios e críticas. 

É pago, no modelo de assinatura, mas vale MUITO a pena. Recomendo 100%.

author: Kelly_christie

title: Great for poor executive functions!
body:
I love this app so much! As a person with ADHD I need to have timed routines so I can do things without feeling overwhelmed, and the visual aspect of this app is so helpful! Besides, I love the awareness and research by the developers ❤️. The only reason I don’t give it 5 starts is because I’m missing some flexibility. 

Suggestions:

I’d love it if routines stayed as a unit rather than becoming individual when you drag them into the calendar, so by changing it in the folder you change all of them, as well as automatically rearranging the times when you change their order. It would also be great if there were a “start now” option and “snoozing” habits, pushing the whole routine forward. 

Im so grateful for this initiative and hope to see it continue to grow. I’m in it for the long run!
author: jardimgarden

body: Tiimo is such a great app for organizing myself, and it being intuitive is even better in this mess we’re in currently. The only reason that I haven’t given it 5 stars is because whenever I try to pick a personalized color for tasks and checklist points, it immediately exits the app. But aside this, I love it so much!!!!
